purpose: Exact visual-reference specification for manually rebuilding each complete static bridal site in Wix Studio.
fidelityTarget: Recreate every route’s structure and visual arrangement, not a shared recolored template. Validate side-by-side at each reference viewport before calling the Wix build 1:1.

globalTokens.imageFit: cover; honor each source image focal position

wixNativeMapping.form: Native Wix Form, same labels/options, same CTA anchor
wixNativeMapping.language: Wix Multilingual instead of the static prototype translation script
wixNativeMapping.menu: Native menu preserving each shop’s unique labels
wixNativeMapping.footer: Native footer section preserving the exact credit, email and concept disclosure
